## What changes

## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run ruff format --check .` and `uv run pytest` pass
- [ ] `uv run python scripts/build_playground.py` rerun if `src/` changed
- [ ] `uv run python scripts/build_coverage.py` and `scripts/build_schemas.py` rerun if the catalog or models changed
- [ ] Every new or changed citation checked against the official text
- [ ] Examples and tests use synthetic data only
